table_description: The primary fact table capturing every individual line-item purchase made at a physical retail store. Each row represents one item sold in one transaction (ticket). At SF100TCL scale this table contains approximately 300 billion rows covering 5 years of sales data across all store locations.
use_cases: Total store revenue and net profit analysis
Monthly and yearly sales trend analysis
data_quality_notes: SS_SOLD_DATE_SK can be NULL for transactions with unknown sale date — always check for NULL when filtering by date.
SS_CUSTOMER_SK can be NULL for anonymous/cash transactions — do not use it to count unique customers without handling NULLs.
SS_NET_PROFIT can be negative — this indicates a loss on a line item (discount exceeded margin).
SS_QUANTITY is the number of units sold; multiply by SS_SALES_PRICE for line-item revenue.
SS_EXT_SALES_PRICE = SS_QUANTITY * SS_SALES_PRICE — use this for revenue aggregations.
SS_NET_PAID is after coupons but before tax. SS_NET_PAID_INC_TAX includes tax.
This table is partitioned on SS_SOLD_DATE_SK — always include a date filter to avoid full scans on 300B rows.
Join to DATE_DIM using SS_SOLD_DATE_SK = D_DATE_SK for time-based analysis.
Join to ITEM using SS_ITEM_SK = I_ITEM_SK for product details.
Join to STORE using SS_STORE_SK = S_STORE_SK for store details.

table_columns.name: SS_SOLD_DATE_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to DATE_DIM.D_DATE_SK. Can be NULL. Use this for all time-based filtering.

table_columns.name: SS_SOLD_TIME_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to TIME_DIM.T_TIME_SK. Time of day the sale occurred. Can be NULL.

table_columns.name: SS_ITEM_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to ITEM.I_ITEM_SK. Part of composite primary key with SS_TICKET_NUMBER.

table_columns.name: SS_CUSTOMER_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to CUSTOMER.C_CUSTOMER_SK. NULL for anonymous transactions.

table_columns.name: SS_CDEMO_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to CUSTOMER_DEMOGRAPHICS.CD_DEMO_SK. Demographic profile of buyer.

table_columns.name: SS_HDEMO_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to HOUSEHOLD_DEMOGRAPHICS.HD_DEMO_SK. Household profile of buyer.

table_columns.name: SS_ADDR_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to CUSTOMER_ADDRESS.CA_ADDRESS_SK. Customer billing address.

table_columns.name: SS_STORE_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to STORE.S_STORE_SK. Which store made the sale.

table_columns.name: SS_PROMO_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to PROMOTION.P_PROMO_SK. Promotion applied to this sale. Can be NULL.

table_columns.name: SS_TICKET_NUMBER
table_columns.description: Transaction receipt number. Combined with SS_ITEM_SK forms the primary key.

table_columns.name: SS_QUANTITY
table_columns.description: Number of units sold for this line item.

table_columns.name: SS_WHOLESALE_COST
table_columns.description: Wholesale cost per unit. Used to calculate gross margin.

table_columns.name: SS_LIST_PRICE
table_columns.description: Retail list (sticker) price per unit before any discounts.

table_columns.name: SS_SALES_PRICE
table_columns.description: Actual selling price per unit after discounts but before coupons.

table_columns.name: SS_EXT_DISCOUNT_AMT
table_columns.description: Total discount amount for this line item (SS_QUANTITY * discount per unit).

table_columns.name: SS_EXT_SALES_PRICE
table_columns.description: Extended sales price = SS_QUANTITY * SS_SALES_PRICE. Primary revenue field.

table_columns.name: SS_EXT_WHOLESALE_COST
table_columns.description: Extended wholesale cost = SS_QUANTITY * SS_WHOLESALE_COST.

table_columns.name: SS_EXT_LIST_PRICE
table_columns.description: Extended list price = SS_QUANTITY * SS_LIST_PRICE.

table_columns.name: SS_EXT_TAX
table_columns.description: Sales tax amount for this line item.

table_columns.name: SS_COUPON_AMT
table_columns.description: Coupon value applied to this line item. Reduces net paid.

table_columns.name: SS_NET_PAID
table_columns.description: Amount actually paid after coupons but before tax. SS_EXT_SALES_PRICE - SS_COUPON_AMT.

table_columns.name: SS_NET_PAID_INC_TAX
table_columns.description: Net paid including tax. SS_NET_PAID + SS_EXT_TAX.

table_columns.name: SS_NET_PROFIT
table_columns.description: Profit on this line item. SS_NET_PAID - SS_EXT_WHOLESALE_COST. Can be negative.
